---
title: "Code Breaker"
description: "A Mastermind-inspired number guessing game"
page-layout: full
---

## Crack the four-digit code

Guess the secret code without being told which digits you got right. You have 10 attempts.

::: {.code-breaker}
<form id="code-breaker-form" class="code-breaker-form">
  <label for="code-guess">Your guess
    <input id="code-guess" name="guess" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" pattern="[0-9]{4}" placeholder="0000" autocomplete="off" required>
  </label>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Check guess</button>
</form>

<p id="code-breaker-status" class="code-breaker-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">You have 10 attempts.</p>

<table class="code-breaker-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Guess</th>
      <th scope="col">Right position</th>
      <th scope="col">Wrong position</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody id="code-breaker-history"></tbody>
</table>

<button id="code-breaker-new-game" class="btn btn-outline-light code-breaker-new-game" type="button">New game</button>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  const form = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-form");
  const input = document.querySelector("#code-guess");
  const status = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-status");
  const history = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-history");
  const newGame = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-new-game");
  const maxAttempts = 10;
  let secretCode;
  let attempts;
  let gameOver;

  function makeCode() {
    return Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join("");
  }

  function scoreGuess(guess) {
    let rightPosition = 0;
    const remainingSecret = [];
    const remainingGuess = [];

    for (let index = 0; index < secretCode.length; index += 1) {
      if (guess[index] === secretCode[index]) {
        rightPosition += 1;
      } else {
        remainingSecret.push(secretCode[index]);
        remainingGuess.push(guess[index]);
      }
    }

    const secretCounts = {};
    const guessCounts = {};
    remainingSecret.forEach((digit) => {
      secretCounts[digit] = (secretCounts[digit] || 0) + 1;
    });
    remainingGuess.forEach((digit) => {
      guessCounts[digit] = (guessCounts[digit] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const wrongPosition = Object.keys(guessCounts).reduce(
      (total, digit) => total + Math.min(guessCounts[digit] || 0, secretCounts[digit] || 0),
      0
    );

    return { rightPosition, wrongPosition };
  }

  function startGame() {
    secretCode = makeCode();
    attempts = 0;
    gameOver = false;
    history.replaceChildren();
    status.textContent = `You have ${maxAttempts} attempts.`;
    input.disabled = false;
    form.querySelector("button").disabled = false;
    input.value = "";
    input.focus();
  }

  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (gameOver) return;

    const guess = input.value;
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(guess)) {
      status.textContent = "Enter exactly four digits.";
      input.focus();
      return;
    }

    attempts += 1;
    const score = scoreGuess(guess);
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML = `<td>${guess}</td><td>${score.rightPosition}</td><td>${score.wrongPosition}</td>`;
    history.prepend(row);

    if (score.rightPosition === 4) {
      status.textContent = `You cracked the code in ${attempts} ${attempts === 1 ? "attempt" : "attempts"}!`;
      gameOver = true;
    } else if (attempts === maxAttempts) {
      status.textContent = `Game over. The code was ${secretCode}. Start a new game to try again.`;
      gameOver = true;
    } else {
      const remaining = maxAttempts - attempts;
      status.textContent = `${score.rightPosition} digit${score.rightPosition === 1 ? "" : "s"} in the right position, ${score.wrongPosition} in the wrong position. ${remaining} attempts left.`;
    }

    input.value = "";
    input.disabled = gameOver;
    form.querySelector("button").disabled = gameOver;
  });

  newGame.addEventListener("click", startGame);
  startGame();
})();
</script>
